reasoning_premium.reason: The live measurement of 2026-10-07 records this model at 0/10 on the refusal corpus and 4/11 on jailbreak, both held to a threshold of 1, while it is the active model of the DeepSeek flash family slot that the reasoning_premium Auto slot names. The model that held the slot before it was recorded at the same two scores. The promotion eval gate ran on this model and refused it; the owner moved the slot to it on 2026-10-07 regardless, as part of keeping only the newest version of every model. No task's preferred slots and no plan's allowed slots include reasoning_premium, so Auto does not dispatch to it and the model is reached only when it is picked by name. Changing which model holds an Auto slot is a founder decision, so this is recorded here rather than silently accepted: no other model may join this list, and no further corpus may join this one.
